findings.summary: Luis Miguel López stated time and non-payment reasons, reported continuing during the transition, and offered further help to Cristo. An announced resignation is not proof of the effective court substitution date.

Renewed withdrawal and subsequent exchange preserve his account of continued work and repeated postponement, his disagreement with alleged procedural disconnection, the client acknowledgement of his contribution and his offer to coordinate document handover. Non-payment is his stated reason; an AC refusal causing departure is not established.
Joaquin notice concerns Gil personally and invokes irreparable lawyer-client breakdown. The email notice and the court filing containing the apology are separate sources.
Armando notice covers the wider client group and invokes lawyer-client breakdown; it also reserves unpaid-fee claims. Same-day notices do not establish exclusive AC causation.
